name: ComfyUI
description: Local Stable Diffusion image server with its own node graph. The install script clones the repo and sets up a venv.

install.windows:
@echo off
rem Install scripts get OAIY_* env vars for OAIY Desktop's dirs.
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI "%OAIY_DATA_DIR%\comfyui"
"%OAIY_DATA_DIR%\python\python.exe" -m venv "%OAIY_VENVS_DIR%\comfyui"
"%OAIY_VENVS_DIR%\comfyui\Scripts\pip.exe" install -r "%OAIY_DATA_DIR%\comfyui\requirements.txt"
